title: Worker output
description: Untrusted worker-to-supervisor result contract from Technical Specification section 4.2.

worker_id.description: Approved C2 or C3 worker identifier.

assessment_status.description: Assessment state from the frozen SP-003 vocabulary.

raw_signal.description: Method-specific raw observations or null on failed/deferred assessment.

access_mode.description: BLACK_BOX, GREY_BOX, WHITE_BOX, INTERNAL_ACTIVATION, or UNAVAILABLE.

coverage_gap_clean_label.description: Permanent T05d coverage-gap label; always true.

non_claims.description: Non-empty claims the evidence does not establish.

dependency_declaration.description: Co-firing detector list and independence status.

error_detail.description: Failure detail for ASSESSMENT_ERROR; null otherwise.
